name: Beyond Mod Manager
notes: Checks and repairs the tested UE4SS runtime during mod installs and updates, including existing and partial installations.
Checks for manager updates on every launch and offers Install update or Later.
Uninstall removes the full selected mod folder, including generated files and settings, so reinstall starts fresh. Recovery backups and game saves are retained.
description: Install and manage Drive Beyond Horizons mods from ZIP files. Keep mod settings, see required support files, and check updates when a mod author provides an update source.
